name: Path String Primitives
description: String primitives for path pipeline composition: template substitution, split, join. Zero dependencies, stdlib only.
description_zh: 路径管道组合用的字符串基础操作：模板替换、切分、合并。零依赖，仅标准库。

directives.usage_zh: 路径字符串;模板,<模板>[,键=值,...]
directives.description: Inline template substitution with {key} placeholders and positional {0} {1} support.
directives.description_zh: 内联模板替换，支持 {key} 占位符和 {0} {1} 位置参数。

directives.usage_zh: 路径字符串;切分,'<字符串>','<分隔符>'
directives.description: Split a string by delimiter into an array.
directives.description_zh: 按分隔符将字符串切分为数组。

directives.usage_zh: 路径字符串;合并,'<JSON数组>','<分隔符>'
directives.description: Join a JSON array into a string with delimiter.
directives.description_zh: 将 JSON 数组用分隔符合并为字符串。
